title: Burning Spiral Portrait
description: A surreal painted portrait of a bald person's face with wide staring eyes and open mouth, centered within a swirling vortex of orange, red, and blue flames and brushstrokes. Black, leafless tree branches emerge from a dark spiral at the bottom, reaching upward toward the face as if burning.
prompt: surreal painted portrait of a bald person's face with wide terrified eyes and open mouth, centered in a dynamic swirling vortex of fiery orange and blue brushstrokes, black leafless tree branches rising from a dark spiral at the bottom reaching toward the face, chaotic burning energy, expressive linework, visible brushstrokes, on torn and burnt paper edges
